## Findings from Last Audit

Mode trigger: 17 commits since 2026-07-08 (PRs #79–#94) plus an `ai_docs/` file-count delta of 22 as intervening sessions shipped 22 backlog rows.

**Verified-clean contracts (checked, not inherited — no changes needed):** AGENTS.md v9+ structure and 8 directive cores; the AGENTS.md ↔ planning_index.md Next-step protocol (verbatim match); architecture.md Code Map (all 27 paths resolve) and Entry points; planning_index.md router contract; workflow.md Backlog closure; the `just` runner and its CI mirror; work-artifact husk GC (zero candidates — every match is a sweep tree `/reconcile-plans` owns); freshness stamps (none present); markdown link targets (zero dead).

**Tool-count verification:** imported the live registry — `TOOL_RECORDS` 91 + `EXPLICIT_TOOL_RECORDS` 11 = **102 catalog**, `refactoring` profile **69**, `analysis` profile **56**. README.md, `runtime.md`, `reference.md`, and `docs/tool-reference.md` all agree; `tests/unit/test_doc_tool_count_drift.py` passes 4/4. Zero drift.

**Fixed this pass (all user-approved):**
- `ai_docs/backlog.md`: replaced 2 unresolvable `templates/items.md` refs (no `templates/` dir exists in this repo) with the real global path `~/.claude/skills/doc-audit/templates/items.md`; normalized the Refs list off its mixed `../CI_POLICY.md` / `ai_docs/workflow.md` convention onto uniform repo-root form; backticked 3 bare row ids.
- `ai_docs/backlog.md` sizing: `cand-find-cyclic-imports` `size: —`→`S` (it has a real prod anchor, so `—` was invalid); `cand-docstring-sync` `L`→`M` after replacing its `TBD — likely new module under tools/refactoring/` anchor with two concrete anchors. The `L` was an artifact of the auditor expanding a bare directory anchor to 34 files, not real scope.
- `ai_docs/README.md`: added `## Work Artifacts` indexing `items/`, `plans/`, `audits/`, `reports/`, `archive/plans/` (all 5 were entirely unindexed); normalized 9 in-tree path refs to file-relative form.
- `ai_docs/domains/python-refactor/mcp-checklist.md`: **10,425 → 1,648 tokens.** The Tool Prompt Bank was 78% of the file; extracted to `tool-prompt-bank/` and split by category into a README index + 3 files, mirroring the `mcp_best_practices/` precedent from the previous pass.
- `README.md`: **632 → 514 tokens** (was over the 600 warn). Removed the Repository Map (duplicated `ai_docs/README.md` §Project Map and `architecture.md` §Code Map); converted the 3-bullet backend description to a table; converted 3 trailing "See X" prose lines to pointer bullets.
- `docs/setup.md`: documented `uv sync --locked --all-extras` — the locked, reproducible install CI uses, previously only in the agent-facing `runtime.md`.
- Archived `ai_docs/plans/20260620T020942Z_top-n-remediation/` and `ai_docs/plans/20260620T215105Z_backlog-sweep/` → `ai_docs/archive/plans/` (both complete, 71 days stable, eligible since ~2026-07-20). Added Refs pointers for both. `ai_docs/plans/` is now empty.

**Not fixed (deliberate, with reasons):**
- `ai_docs/prompts/deep-review-refactor.md` (5,280 tok, 5% over warn) — inspected for redundancy and found none. It is 22 distinct refactoring procedures and already delegates the tool list to `reference.md`. Trimming to satisfy a warn threshold would degrade a working prompt for no gain; it sits at 53% of its hard cap.
- Root `README.md` density (50% vs 60% target) — shortfall is structural (code fences + headings), not prose. See Known Gaps.

**Bad-code surfacing (Directive #3) — 77 files scanned, 4 rows filed:**
- **Zero `block`-severity:** no hardcoded credentials, no TODO/FIXME/HACK/XXX markers, no commented-out code blocks.
- **Root pattern found — a remediation that never generalized.** `tools/search/{dead_code,structural,symbols,unused_symbols}.py`, `tools/metrics/dependencies.py`, and `tools/refactoring/circular_imports.py` were fixed (PRs #83/#90/#92) to surface per-file failures via `BackendFailure` / skipped-file reporting. Eight sibling scanners still swallow per-file `SyntaxError`/`OSError` with zero caller-visible signal. Filed as 3 size-compliant slices rather than one oversized row:
  - `security-scan-silent-file-drop` (Medium/S) — `metrics/security.py:37`. Highest severity: `_scan_file` returns `[]` on parse failure, so an unparseable file is reported identically to a clean one. A security false negative.
  - `metrics-scanner-silent-file-drop` (Low/M) — `metrics/{architecture.py:101, complexity.py:72, coverage.py:28, duplicates.py:38}`.
  - `metrics-search-scanner-silent-file-drop` (Low/M) — `metrics/{test_map.py:41, unused.py:65,99}`, `search/constructors.py:{47,123,172}`.
- `tool-registry-stale-registration-docstring` (Low/S) — `tool_registry.py:24-26` states the 11 non-trivial wrappers "remain explicit `@mcp.tool` functions in `server.py`". There are **zero** `@mcp.tool` decorators in `server.py`; they are `ToolRecord` entries in `EXPLICIT_TOOL_RECORDS` (server.py:344-356) passed via `extra_records=`. The file contradicts its own `register_tools` docstring. Drifted in PR #91.
- **Examined and deliberately NOT filed:** `navigation/hierarchy.py:{81,113}` and `navigation/outline.py:80` also return empty on `(OSError, SyntaxError)`, but they are best-effort positional/folding *refinement* helpers with a caller-side primary path — a fallback, not a result-dropping scanner.

**Retention / husk-GC verdicts:**
- Work-artifact husk GC: **zero candidates**. Every file in the eligible-set glob is either `planning_index.md` (explicitly excluded) or inside a timestamped sweep/remediation tree that `/reconcile-plans` owns.
- `audit-reports/application-brainstorm.md` — carried as **bucket C (keep)**; BRAIN ideas remain live intake for the backlog (`cand-docstring-sync` cites BRAIN-007, `cand-convert-typeddict-pydantic` cites BRAIN-003).
- `ai_docs/audits/` and `ai_docs/reports/` — both content-superseded but under their count limits; left in place per the standard.
